title: SNAP: A Benchmark for Testing the Effects of Capture Conditions on Fundamental Vision Tasks

bias_targets.target: Capture bias (Sensor parameter and lighting bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Extracting and analyzing Exif metadata (shutter speed, ISO, aperture) from 13 common vision datasets to identify distribution imbalances, and evaluating 52 deep learning models on a novel dataset (SNAP) with densely sampled camera settings and controlled lighting to measure performance fluctuations across different exposure levels.

Analyzing the distribution of image capture years in training datasets and observing model misclassifications on modern objects (e.g., smartphones) due to being trained predominantly on outdated images (e.g., pre-2009 flip phones).
